title: APK-based UPI fraud with mule chain — 18 Sep 2026
narrative: On 18 Sep 2026 at 13:41 IST, victim received a phishing email purportedly from SBI, originating from IP 103.45.12.88 (SPF fail). A spoofed call from N1 (13:52) followed by an SMS from N2 (14:02) containing a malicious APK link prompted the victim to install the APK at 14:09. The APK exfiltrated credentials, enabling an unauthorised UPI debit of ₹4,85,000 from the victim's account at 14:31:40. Funds were immediately split: ₹2,40,000 to M2 and ₹2,45,000 to M3, then further routed through M4 to exchange E1. M3 withdrew ₹2,00,000 in two ATM transactions within 20 minutes.
